## Change and evidence

Describe the change, affected source IDs, release, and related issue. Provide primary URLs and persistent identifiers, inspected passage/table/abstract, study design and limitations. Explain title/version differences or dataset overlap.

## Checks

- [ ] No invented metadata, unsupported result, or silent promotion of a candidate.
- [ ] Verification dates and inspected scope accurately describe work performed.
- [ ] Build and local validation pass; reference verification report is attached or limitations explained.
- [ ] Changelog and generated outputs are consistent; published snapshots are unchanged.
- [ ] Relevant interests and AI assistance are disclosed.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this material under the repository's content/code licenses.
